answer.rationale: Write-path p99 at 5x coincides with a release 2h ago (latency rise began ~30m after deploy) during an expected daily settlement peak. A planned daily peak alone is a weak explanation for a 5x regression if headroom is normally provisioned; the release is the strongest reversible suspect. Rollback is the only candidate that both targets that suspect and keeps taking customer writes (unlike a circuit breaker). Failover and read-replica routing are unsupported here (no regional signal; settlement load is writes, not dashboard reads). Capacity may still be needed if the release is innocent, which remains possible. Verify b1 before committing; keep the rollback staged rather than a full blast given residual causal uncertainty and peak write volume.
